description: This Java source file defines the TestEvent class used for testing event handling within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, entity identification, header management, and metadata access.

classes.name: TestEvent
classes.description: Represents a test event used within the Ditto framework, implementing the Event interface with serialization, identification, and header support.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns empty DittoHeaders associated with this event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new TestEvent instance with the provided DittoHeaders (though headers are not stored in this implementation).

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity identifier associated with this event.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns an empty string as resource type.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a TestEvent from a JsonObject and headers, using a fixed entity ID.

methods.name: alternativeFromJson
methods.description: Alternate static method to create a TestEvent with a different fixed entity ID.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new TestEvent instance with the same entity ID; revision not stored.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional for timestamp.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional for metadata.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the manifest.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JsonObject given a schema version and predicate.
